title: Crew Charge Schedule: Included Attempts, Redelivery and Refusal Figures
content:
Attempts included, the charge for an attempt beyond those included, and the charge for goods refused at the door:
the schedule below sets each of them for every fulfilment service of Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment. The
included attempts are the attempts made at no further charge; the redelivery fee is the charge for an attempt beyond
those included; and the refusal percentage is the charge for goods refused at the door, taken as a percentage of the
line.

| Fulfilment service | Attempts included | Redelivery fee, per attempt beyond those included | Refusal charge, percent of the line |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Parcel Delivery | 2 | 9.99 | 0 |
| Store Pickup Hold | 0 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Threshold Delivery | 2 | 49.00 | 10 |
| Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | 2 | 59.00 | 10 |
| White Glove Delivery and Installation | 2 | 99.00 | 10 |
| Business Dock and Freight Delivery | 1 | 175.00 | 12 |

## Counting the attempts (hypothetical attempt counts)

On a service that includes 2 attempts, a first and a second attempt sit inside the included figure and a third
attempt is an attempt beyond those included; on Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away the figure attaching to such a
third attempt is 59.00. Business Dock and Freight Delivery includes 1 attempt, so on that service the second attempt
is already an attempt beyond those included and the figure attaching to it is 175.00. Store Pickup Hold includes 0
attempts and carries a nil redelivery figure.

## Working the refusal percentage (hypothetical line value)

The refusal percentage is taken on the line. On Threshold Delivery, whose refusal percentage is 10, a line of 800.00
gives 80.00; on Business Dock and Freight Delivery, whose percentage is 12, the same line of 800.00 gives 96.00. On
Standard Parcel Delivery and Store Pickup Hold the percentage is 0, so the same line gives nil.
